_comment: Dataset catalog. Counts are SOURCE-REPORTED unless marked 'audited'. Do not sum counts across records: several overlap (noted in known_overlap). Acquisition metadata checked against publisher APIs on 2026-10-23.

records.name: BTXRD: Bone Tumor X-ray Radiograph dataset
records.summary: First milestone dataset. Radiographs with image-level labels, tumor boxes/masks and clinical fields.

counts.patients: unknown: release has no patient or lesion id

labels.annotation_format: LabelMe 5.4.1 JSON, one file per tumor image
labels.reference_standard: paper reports histology or confirmation by two radiology experts, with pathology absent for some images; per-image confirmation method remains unresolved (primary paper reviewed 2026-10-24)

unresolved: patient grouping: dataset.xlsx has no patient or lesion id, and the paper says several views can show the same lesion
device per image (center and anatomic site are in dataset.xlsx)
label errors: 2 byte-identical image pairs are labeled benign in one copy and normal in the other (IMG000591/IMG003456, IMG000707/IMG003346); 21 exact-duplicate pairs in total
overlap with other public bone X-ray sets

records.name: BreastMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
records.summary: Breast ultrasound, benign+normal vs malignant, preprocessed to small npz arrays. Good for fast pipeline tests.
unresolved: MedMNIST splits may not respect patient grouping of the source dataset
records.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2, Scientific Data 2023; data doi:10.5281/zenodo.10519652; source: Al-Dhabyani et al. 2020

records.name: PathMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
records.summary: Colorectal cancer histology tiles, 9 tissue classes (from NCT-CRC-HE-100K / CRC-VAL-HE-7K). 28px and 64px versions.
unresolved: tiles from the same slide/patient cannot be grouped from the npz alone
records.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Kather et al. 2019 (NCT-CRC-HE)

records.name: NoduleMNIST3D (MedMNIST v3 record)
records.summary: 3D lung nodule crops from LIDC-IDRI with benign/malignant labels derived from radiologist suspicion ratings (not pathology).

labels.reference_standard: radiologist malignancy ratings, not confirmed diagnosis

records.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Armato et al. 2011 (LIDC-IDRI)

records.name: LIDC-IDRI sample (3 CT series)
records.summary: Three pinned CT series for adapter smoke tests and DICOM ingestion. Not an evaluation set: LIDC is in the MONAI lung bundle's training data.

labels.note: Radiologist XML annotations are distributed separately on TCIA and are not included.

records.name: DermaMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
records.summary: Dermatoscopic images from HAM10000, 7 diagnostic classes.
unresolved: HAM10000 has multiple images per lesion; MedMNIST split may leak lesions across partitions
records.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Tschandl et al. 2018 (HAM10000)

records.name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon Task01 BrainTumour
records.summary: Multimodal brain MRI (FLAIR, T1w, T1gd, T2w) with tumor sub-region labels, derived from BraTS 2016/2017. For brain adapter testing only: overlaps BraTS 2018 training data of the MONAI bundle.

labels.note: Label convention differs from the BraTS 2018 bundle's TC/WT/ET outputs; map explicitly.

records.citation: Antonelli et al. 2022, The Medical Segmentation Decathlon, Nat Commun

records.name: MURA musculoskeletal radiographs
records.summary: Normal/abnormal upper-extremity studies. Abnormal is not cancer; possible representation/robustness research only.

acquisition.instructions: Register at https://stanfordmlgroup.github.io/competitions/mura/ and accept the research use agreement yourself; place files in data/mura/ and write a PROVENANCE.json.

records.name: LIDC-IDRI (full)
records.summary: 1,010 subjects / 244,527 DICOM images (~133 GB per archive). Suspicion ratings are not confirmed malignancy.

acquisition.instructions: Too large for the local budget. Add more pinned series to lidc-idri-sample, or use the NBIA Data Retriever on the big machine.

records.name: BraTS 2021 challenge data
records.summary: Brain tumor MRI segmentation challenge release; partitions and labels are release-specific.

acquisition.instructions: Requires Synapse registration and challenge terms; obtain it yourself. Check overlap with BraTS 2018 and MSD before evaluating any bundle.

records.name: PANDA prostate biopsy challenge
records.summary: 10,616 biopsies / 2,113 patients (published dev set). Group by patient.

acquisition.instructions: Kaggle competition data (hundreds of GB). Big machine only, after accepting Kaggle rules yourself.

records.name: CAMELYON16
records.summary: Lymph-node whole-slide images for metastasis research. Check encoder pretraining overlap.

acquisition.instructions: Hundreds of GB of WSIs; big machine only. PathMNIST covers local pathology prototyping.

records.name: ISIC Archive
records.summary: Skin lesion images across many collections; per-image licenses differ.

acquisition.instructions: Use the ISIC API with license filters for a small subset; dedupe lesions across releases. DermaMNIST covers quick local tests.

records.name: TCGA (via GDC)
records.summary: 33 cancer types; molecular, clinical and slide data. Open vs controlled access differ.

labels.note: Pick processed open-access files for a defined question

acquisition.instructions: Query the GDC API for open-access processed files for one project; never request controlled data without approval.
